context_for_next_testing_agent: CP8.5 CompanyCombobox is fully resolved as of this iteration. Both original white-datalist bug (iter 72) and dropdown-reopens-after-click UX polish (iter 73) are verified fixed. EditTaskModal untouched and confirmed still using native <select data-testid='edit-company'>.
rca of the issue: commitOption() calls inputRef.focus() to preserve keyboard flow after mouse selection. The input's onFocus handler unconditionally setOpen(true), causing the just-closed dropdown to reopen immediately. Fix introduces a useRef flag `suppressOpenOnFocus` that commitOption sets to true right before calling focus(); onFocus checks-and-clears the flag before deciding to open, so exactly one focus event is suppressed. Subsequent focuses (user clicks or Tab) open normally.
